description: A video's transcript in another language, with every segment and timestamp kept. Free first: the transcript as is when it is already in that language, then the platform's own track or machine translation (YouTube translated captions), then LLM translation on the free-first rung chain. The source transcript is saved unchanged; the translation is an added layer. Text output starts with a header naming the video and how it was translated; other formats come with a second content block reporting the path used and the attempts. Costs about as many tokens as the transcript itself (about 12k per hour of speech).

format.description: Output format: text, json, markdown, srt, vtt, pack, ass, ttml, sbv, lrc, csv. Default text. json returns the full result, source transcript included

llm.description: Allow LLM translation when the platform has no track in the language. Default true; false uses only the platform's tracks

mode.description: How to get the source transcript: auto (captions, then speech-to-text), captions, stt or video. Default auto

timestamps.description: Prefix lines with [m:ss] where the format allows. Default false

url.description: Video URL (YouTube and more), a YouTube video id, or a local media file path

name: translate_transcript
title: Translate transcript
